entries.claim: The direct collect body calls $Per eundem; the exact shared conclusion and Amen have a separate declared dependency.

The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.

The shared Father-directed formula supplies conclusion words w030-w051 and response w052 Amen. It does not print the proper body or by itself establish response participation. House accents, ligatures, tuum: Qui and terminal Amen. are declared in the transcript.
RG115b prescribes Per eundem Dominum nostrum when the Father-directed prayer mentions the Son at its beginning; this supports eundem at w031 in the proper's abbreviated cue.
The Benziger 1962 proper prints the 29-word collect body and Per eundem Dominum cue. The 52-word witness explicitly expands RG115a-b, including Amen, with declared house accidentals.
